about_the_game:
Pre-purchase now and get the Floating Mountains Bonus Content, including three different color patterns to customize your banshee and immerse yourself further in the Western Frontier.

Requires the base game to play.

Play as So’lek, a Na’vi warrior who has found solace with the Sarentu. Just as peace settles over the Western Frontier, a new threat rises: the RDA, now allied with the Ash clan, who are ruthless Na’vi bent on annihilation. Ambushed and left for dead, So’lek awakens to a scorched land and his new-found family scattered. With new third-person gameplay, embark on So’lek’s journey as he vows to find his family and exact revenge on those who wronged him.

EMBARK ON A JOURNEY OF VENGEANCE
Return to Pandora as So'lek, a warrior haunted by his past. Struggling to find inner peace, his world is shattered once more as he faces a terrifying enemy and fights to rescue his Sarentu family.

PLAY A NEW THIRD-PERSON EXPERIENCE
Take on the fight for the Western Frontier as a powerful Na’vi warrior in an experience designed for third-person gameplay – while remaining playable at your choice in first-person. With a streamlined progression system, enhanced combat, and brutal takedown finishers, utilize stealth or go guns blazing to fight for your loved ones.

STAND AGAINST YOUR OWN
Face the Ash clan, the ruthless Na’vi seeking power over Pandora. Confront this new threat in combat and epic boss fights as the Ash clan leverage their knowledge of Na’vi strengths and weaknesses to assert their dominance.

NAVIGATE A WORLD RAVAGED BY DESTRUCTION
Uncover the chaos of the Kinglor Forest, a once-thriving land now set ablaze by an empowered RDA and a warband of Ash clan warriors.
